title: Lead Software Engineer - ToolHound (.net)
description: Where the Work Is: Beacon buys great vertical software businesses and makes them dramatically more valuable, not by squeezing them, but by giving them world-class engineering and AI leadership they could never hire on their own. Our engineers go where the work is: embedded inside a single business, owning its technology end to end, and compounding its enterprise value quarter over quarter. This role is one of those seats. You will be the technical leader for ToolHound , a mature, profitable tool-and-asset-management platform used by industrial, construction, energy, and manufacturing customers to track where every tool and asset is, who has it, and what it costs them. You won't advise from the outside. You'll own the codebase, set the roadmap, lead the team, and be measured on the value you create. This is an AI-native rebuild, not maintenance. ToolHound is a profitable, established platform, and the mandate is to reimagine what it does with AI at the center, and you're the technical leader who owns that from the front. We're looking for a jack of all trades , a strong generalist who can go deep where it counts. Deep, current .NET expertise is the price of entry, because that's what ToolHound is built on today. Over time, ToolHound converges onto Beacon's shared engineering standards, and you'll be the one leading that journey. The right person is excited by both, mastering the stack in front of them and growing into a broader one. What You'll Do: Own the technical and product roadmap. Decide what gets built and why, in partnership with the GM and customers. Translate business priorities (retention, expansion, new verticals, operational leverage) into a sequenced engineering plan you're accountable for. Drive everything technical. Architecture, code quality, security, data modeling, performance, release engineering, and the migration path. You set the bar and you'll make the final technical decision. Ship AI that changes the business, not demos. Take the natural-language assistant and the broader AI surface from plan to production: evals, guardrails, tenant-safe tool use, and features customers feel. You know when to lean on a foundation model, when to fine-tune, and how to keep agentic workflows on the rails in a multi-tenant system. Lead and grow the team. Mentor the current engineer, raise their ceiling, and establish the best practices. Increase velocity and harden the codebase. Make shipping faster and safer: modernize the stack, tighten the SQL and data layer, invest in test coverage and automation, and pay down risk so the platform can carry far more weight than it does today. Be the technical face of ToolHound. Earn the trust of operators and customers, set expectations, and communicate clearly in writing. What We're Looking For: A senior .NET expert — day one. Deep, current C# / ASP.NET Core (through .NET 8–10), comfortable owning a large, mature codebase immediately: reading it, fixing it, and reshaping it with judgment. This is the non-negotiable starting requirement. A genuine generalist ("jack of all trades"). You're T-shaped, deep in .NET now, but you pick up new languages, stacks, and clouds quickly and enjoy it. You can move across web, mobile, data, infra, and AI without waiting for permission, and you're energized (not threatened) by converging onto TypeScript/React, Go, Python, and AWS over time. Cloud and SQL depth. You've designed, deployed, and operated real systems in the cloud, and can model, query, tune, and reason about production databases. Mobile fluency. Hands-on with cross-platform mobile: .NET MAUI (or Xamarin/ native, with the ability to go deep on MAUI), including scanning, camera, and offline sync. AI-native engineering. You've shipped production software on foundation models (LLM tool use, retrieval, evals, guardrails), not just prototypes, and you have a point of view on doing it safely in a multi-tenant product. Technical leadership. You've led engineers.  Set direction, mentored, raised quality in a small, high-ownership team where the leader still ships code. Product and business instinct. You can read what actually drives the business, prioritize accordingly, and defend a roadmap to a GM and to customers. A strong writer and communicator who builds trust with non-engineers. Nice to Have: Experience across our target technologies — TypeScript/React, Go, Python , AWS , Kubernetes , infrastructure-as-code, modern CI/CD, Postgres , and metrics/product-analytics tooling — or a track record of learning stacks like these fast. Vertical / B2B or industrial SaaS experience (asset management, inventory, field service, logistics, construction tech). RFID / IoT / hardware-integrated systems. DevExpress reporting, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, or licensing systems. Experience modernizing or re-platforming a legacy .NET codebase without a disruptive rewrite. Our Values at Beacon Software Humility : We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. Honesty : We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. Hunger : We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. Horizon : We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth. How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.
